grades.quote: This chapter describes the RISC-V ISA extension naming scheme that is used to concisely describe the set of instructions present in a hardware implementation, or the set of instructions used by an application binary interface (ABI).
grades.reason: This is the intro to the RISC-V ISA extension naming scheme, which describes the set of instructions in an implementation. It is only auxiliary. It gives a naming convention, not a facility for discovering processor identity or supported extensions at run time, such as misa or vendor ID registers.
